definition: מַשְׂרֵת noun masculine apparently = pan, dish , Palestinian Aramaic מסרית , only ׳ וַתִּקּח הַמּ 2Sam 13:9 and she took the pan ; perhaps = מַשְׂאֶרֶת ֗֗֗ , originally dough-pan ( שׂאר ), kneading-trough, Gei Urschr.382f We (not Dr ); > Klo Bu Ry in Di Exod 12:34 (3te Aufl.) ( אֶתֿ ) וִתִּקְרָא הַמְּשָׁרֵת and she called the servant ( HPS del. v.)
